name: Standard scramble route
descent_text: Reverse the route: from the summit, follow the path back down the steep rocky upper section to the flat stretch, then to Abiel Pass, and descend the cairned side trail to the PCT. Turn north on the PCT for the walk back to the road. The rock is loose in many places, so descend carefully and keep clear of other parties below.
approach: Park along Forest Road 9070 where it meets the Pacific Crest Trail at a saddle (about 3,800 ft), roughly six miles from Hyak. Walk the PCT south for about 1.7 miles to a cairned side trail that doubles back uphill; a tarn on your left means you overshot it. The side path climbs about 0.3 mile with a few class 2-3 moves to Abiel Pass, the saddle between Tinkham and Silver peaks, where the scramble up the summit slopes begins.
